# AI Platform Engineer — Wayne Enterprises

**Location:** Remote (EU) · **Type:** Full-time · **Posted:** 2026-08-25

## About the role

Wayne Enterprises is building an internal platform for deploying and evaluating LLM-backed products.
You will own the inference-serving layer, the evaluation harness, and the prompt-management tooling
used by ~40 product engineers.

## Responsibilities

- Design and run the model inference gateway (routing, caching, cost controls)
- Build the offline + online evaluation harness for prompt and model changes
- Maintain the RAG indexing pipeline and its freshness monitoring
- Partner with product teams on agent-framework patterns

## Requirements

- 5+ years backend engineering, 2+ years working directly with LLM APIs
- Strong Python; comfortable with TypeScript
- Experience with vector databases and retrieval evaluation
- Track record operating production ML or data infrastructure

## Compensation

€110,000–€135,000 + equity. Visa sponsorship available for EU relocation.
